buttons.secondary: bg-[#F3EFE7] text-[#2D3339] hover:bg-[#EAE5D9] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 on cards, text color darkening, shadow depth increase.
motion_and_interaction.entrance: Staggered fade-up for directory grid items.

hero_background.description: Warm, sun-drenched Southern California beach sunrise. Use as hero background with gradient overlay.

featured_bed_1.description: Modern California home exterior, warm lighting, trustworthy.

daily_reflection_bg.description: Blue ocean, peaceful waves, use as background for reflection cards.

icons.style: Use lucide-react with strokeWidth={1.5} for an elegant, non-clinical feel. Use them for amenities (pool, parking, pets), contact, and navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Fraunces' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Load them via Google Fonts in index.html.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are added to all interactive elements.
Apply 'bg-[#FDFBF7]' globally for the body. Do not use generic white background everywhere.
Design the landing page with a hero section overlaying the 'hero_background' image, heavily utilizing the 'hero_overlay' gradient so text is readable.
Implement the 'Beds Directory' grid using the 'cards' layout and 'surfaces_and_textures.cards'.
Avoid AI-slop: NEVER use purple/violet gradients, Inter, Roboto, or generic shadow styles.
Do not use Shadcn card for the actual bed listings if it limits layout. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for editorial bento grids and asymmetric designs.
Ensure the header navigation is sticky and uses 'glass_header' design.
Keep forms (Post Listing) clean, leveraging standard inputs but stylized with rounded-xl borders.
For sponsorships (Lawyers, Dealerships), use Lucide icons with solid backgrounds if brand logos aren't provided.
